_note: P146 D1. A Class A impurity budget for a stainless-steel-like activated metal (Fe balance; Cr 18, Ni 8, Mn 1.5 wt% matrix; Co 0.05, N 0.05, Nb 0.01 wt% specification levels) at the 33-year and 101-year cooling steps (12 and 13) of the P145 C2 schedule. nuclide_properties is the token from_decay_data: controls/check_p146.py replaces it by the properties of every radionuclide of the primary and fallback decay files named by the base spec (half-life, Z, alpha emission by the P145 rule) when it stages the case, because a budget needs the properties of every nuclide an element solve produces. Keys starting with an underscore are removed by the checker.
